bio: Olivier Guenoun, chef of this family business since 2010, crafts recipes that appeal to modern tastebuds in a menu dotted with daily specials that vary with market availability. Just like the regulars to the Pelican, open your beak wide to sample a slice of Nantais cake, a ubiquitous regional classic, treated to a new twist with roast pineapple and a mojito sorbet!...
